Science and Analytics* at

and help shape the
future of AI! 🤖✨

🎯 Target Start: Fall 2027
🗓️ Application Deadline: February 1, 2027

>>Kennesaw State University is waiving application fees for all
undergraduate and graduate applicants through November, making higher
education more accessible for prospective students.<<

The AIology Lab at KSU is inviting applications for PhD students who are
passionate about advancing the science and application of Artificial
Intelligence and Analytics. Our mission is to design, evaluate, and apply
AI-driven solutions that power data-informed decision-making across health,
business, and social systems.

Research Areas Include:
- Human-AI Interaction
- Machine Behaviour
- Anthropomorphic AI
- Information Disorder
- Text mining and NLP
- Health and Medical Informatics

🌟 Why Join Us?
• Work on meaningful, real-world AI challenges
• Collaborate in an interdisciplinary research environment
• Publish in top-tier journals and conferences
• Be part of a growing, innovative research community

💰 Competitive Financial Support
• $3,000/month financial support
• Full tuition waiver
• Health insurance coverage

🏙️ Bonus: Live, Learn, and Innovate Near Atlanta!
KSU’s Marietta campus offers the perfect blend of academic excellence and
quality of life—just minutes from Atlanta, one of the fastest-growing tech
and innovation hubs in the U.S. Enjoy:
• Access to a vibrant tech ecosystem and industry partnerships
• Rich cultural diversity and international community
• World-class restaurants, entertainment, and sports
• Warm weather, beautiful parks, and outdoor activities
• Big-city opportunities with a lower cost of living than many metro areas
✈️ Plus, benefit from proximity to Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International
Airport, one of the world’s busiest and best-connected airports, making
national and international travel incredibly convenient for conferences,
collaborations, and adventures!

👩‍🎓 Ideal Candidates:
• Background in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Science,
Health/Medical Informatics, Information Systems, Statistics, HCI,
Computational Social Science, or related fields
• Strong programming & ML skills
• Passion for AI/LLMs applied to health, business, and society

📬 Interested? Let’s Connect! 📧
Send your CV, best publication (optional), a copy of your BS+MS
transcripts, a copy of your GRE and TOEFL/IELTS (for international
students), and a brief research statement (one paragraph) to:
*

>*.
**Emails missing these attachments will not receive a response.**
